description: Flood Dykes Lower Fraser and Squamish Rivers - Lower Mainland - Points is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Regional Operations - South Coast. Dykes and Dyke Stationing Points for the Lower Fraser and Squamish Rivers in the Lower Mainland Region. Created March 1998. Last update September 2004. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Regional Operations - South Coast. Its tags are Fraser River, Land Use, Lower Mainland Region, Squamish River, Surrey. The portal shows 2025-07-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
